response.what_it_is: PlayStation Portal remote player in original retail box
visible_condition: retail box is visible and intact
hidden_risks: Whether the actual PlayStation Portal device is inside the box
Screen condition, scratches, or dead pixels on the handheld device
Battery health and functionality of the triggers and joysticks
Presence of original charging cable and accessories
seller_claims_unsupported: openbox condition cannot be verified without seeing the contents
response.failure_mode: Pricing the item as a brand new sealed unit based solely on the retail box photo, or assuming the device is fully functional and inside without visual confirmation.
